name: Andrzej Halicki - Après le § 10 - Am 13
title: REPORT on the Council position on Draft amending budget No 2/2026 of the European Union for the financial year 2026 – Update on revenue (own resources) and adjustments to expenditure
part_text: 10b. Recalls that, rather than creating new own resources, which would impose an unjustified additional burden on individuals and businesses, it is essential to ensure the effective collection of revenue already due to the Union budget, a significant proportion of which remains uncollected as a result of fraud, under-reporting and inadequate controls; underlines that customs fraud and VAT fraud, in particular, have been consistently documented by the European Court of Auditors and the European Public Prosecutor’s Office;
